body.heading: Where in the world is United Kingdom?
paragraphs: United Kingdom is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of United Kingdom is London.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in United Kingdom is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of United Kingdom is the British pound.

body.heading: How big is United Kingdom?
paragraphs: United Kingdom covers about 243,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Spain.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: London packs in wonders: the Tower of London's Crown Jewels, Big Ben and the Thames, plus free museums of dinosaurs, rockets and mummies.
Edinburgh Castle crowns a volcanic rock above the Royal Mile's narrow closes — and the city hosts the world's biggest arts festival each August.
